purpose: Freeze the registry, exact definitions that are supportable before source selection, and four explicitly proxy-only predictor contracts for seven missing-variable families; leave underdefined continuous predictors source-definition-blocked without opening response, confirmation, holdout, or independent rows and without scoring any formula.

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: SPARC Mass Models machine-readable radial table and published baryonic-component columns
resolved 3.6 micron photometry, HI surface-density maps, and frozen distance/inclination metadata
resolved HI velocity-dispersion and surface-density products independent of Vobs residuals
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: public survey products to be source-audited

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: distance/inclination covariance, neighbor catalog, and predictor-only star-formation or interaction-history products
bound eight-cluster concentration, centroid-shift, Gini, Zernike, cool-core, assembly-literature, and boundary-method metadata
joint X-ray/SZ/lensing deprojection or orientation posterior with axis-ratio covariance
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: public object-level product to be identified and audited

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: object-level gas-motion product disjoint from scored X-COP T_X and P_SZ, publishing f_nth directly with provenance/covariance or supplying sigma_3d plus temperature from a separately frozen predictor-only source
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: public spectroscopy or validated simulation-calibrated product to be audited

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: XMM/Planck calibration covariance, mean-to-median density clumping profiles, and measured outer SZ boundary with predictor-side scaling
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: X-COP public products and calibration releases to be audited

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: neighbor/tidal catalog and continuous merger or sloshing time posterior
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: public catalogs and primary-source supplemental products to be audited

public_source_catalog.public_source_or_file: official retrievable X-GAP or replacement alias manifest plus direct density, pressure, temperature, stellar, and covariance files
group-scale geometry, gas-motion, clumping, calibration, boundary, environment, and assembly products joined by frozen aliases
public_source_catalog.url_or_archive: XMM, Chandra, eROSITA, optical/IR, and SZ public archives after source audit

variable_registry.label: three-dimensional geometry and orientation

dimensionless_predictor.physical_range: positive; q_los=1 is spherical in the declared convention
dimensionless_predictor.reference_convention: a_sky and b_sky are the major and minor sky-plane semi-axes and c_los is the line-of-sight semi-axis of one source-tracer isodensity ellipsoid at R_ref=Rbar50; Rbar50 encloses 50 percent of the predictor-side baryonic mass within frozen observational support

lane_specific_tracer.SPARC_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: joint stellar-plus-gas baryonic density reconstructed from predictor maps
lane_specific_tracer.XCOP_EIGHT_EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT: electron-density isosurface from predictor-side X-ray surface brightness/deprojection
lane_specific_tracer.GROUP_SOURCE_AUDIT_LANES: electron-density isosurface from the frozen direct deprojection packet

variable_registry.physical_provenance: A three-axis deprojection or orientation posterior, never a fit to candidate residuals or total-mass targets.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Carry the full axis-ratio/orientation posterior jointly with centering and radial deprojection; morphology proxies form a separately reported sensitivity channel and may not be relabeled as q_los measurements.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: No imputation from object identity, residual sign, inferred mass, or response morphology; retain a missing indicator only for audit and run complete-case plus source-missingness sensitivity.
forbidden_response_derived_substitutes: hydrostatic or lensing total-mass axis ratio

domain_applicability.blocker: inclination and projected axis ratio do not identify c_los without a thickness/orientation prior and covariance
bound morphology values are projected disturbance proxies; no c_los posterior is bound
zero group lanes have a retrievable alias-bound deprojection packet

prospective_test.falsification_rule: With q_los frozen before response access, require a preregistered monotone residual association or out-of-sample score gain in the same direction across eligible lanes; inconsistent signs or no gain at the frozen precision falsifies q_los as the shared missing variable.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Set q_los=1 and compare against posterior integration over q_los at identical formula complexity and object splits.

variable_registry.label: nonthermal or unresolved kinetic support

lane_specific_conventions.SPARC_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: typed cold-gas analog f_ad=sigma_R^2/(Vbar^2+sigma_R^2), with Vbar computed only from predictor-side gas and stellar mass maps; f_ad is never pooled numerically with hot-gas f_nth
lane_specific_conventions.XCOP_EIGHT_EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT: use a directly published f_nth posterior from a product disjoint from scored T_X and P_SZ, or P_nth=rho_g*sigma_3d^2/3 and P_th=rho_g*k_B*T_pred/(mu*m_p) only when T_pred comes from a separately hash-frozen predictor source not used as scored T_X
lane_specific_conventions.GROUP_SOURCE_AUDIT_LANES: same hot-gas convention as X-COP after a direct f_nth product or disjoint sigma_3d plus predictor-only T_pred source is selected and alias-bound

dimensionless_predictor.source_selection_rule: The direct-f_nth path and the sigma_3d-plus-T_pred path are mutually exclusive preregistered source choices; until one exact product is selected the continuous predictor is SOURCE_DEFINITION_BLOCKED.

variable_registry.physical_provenance: A gas-motion product whose files, reduction, covariance, and thermal reference are disjoint from scored X-COP T_X and P_SZ and from candidate residuals; the frozen morphology/cool-core/assembly channel remains only a proxy.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: For a direct f_nth release, carry its published radial covariance. For the derived path, jointly propagate sigma_3d, rho_g, mu, and independently frozen predictor-side T_pred covariance. Scored T_X, P_SZ, response-derived thermal pressure, and the Item 59 fitted nonthermal setting are forbidden.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: No morphology-to-f_nth point imputation; morphology/cool-core/assembly flags may be tested only as explicitly labeled proxies with separate missingness strata.
forbidden_response_derived_substitutes: thermal pressure derived from any scored response

domain_applicability.blocker: resolved gas dispersion and beam covariance are not hash-bound
relaxation, cool-core, and assembly labels are proxies; no independent radial f_nth product is bound
no direct gas-motion packet or covariance is verified

prospective_test.falsification_rule: Freeze f_nth(r) from independent gas-motion data and require held-out improvement without refitting the gravity law; failure to improve or a required unphysical fraction falsifies nonthermal support as the missing explanation.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Compare full posterior integration with f_nth(r)=0 and with morphology proxies removed one at a time.

variable_registry.label: instrument, distance, inclination, and cross-survey calibration

dimensionless_predictor.definition: ln(S_k/S_ref,k) for each separately named calibration source k; delta_cal is a vector and may not be collapsed to a fitted object offset
dimensionless_predictor.physical_range: real; every component is centered at zero under its hash-bound reference

SPARC_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: k=distance: S_k=D and S_ref,k is the nominal distance in the selected hash-bound SPARC metadata row
k=inclination: S_k=sin(i) and S_ref,k=sin(i_ref) from the same selected metadata release
k=3.6um_flux: S_k is the applied 3.6um flux zero-point and S_ref,k is the exact published zero-point in the selected photometric calibration file
XCOP_EIGHT_EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT: k=XMM_effective_area: S_k=A_X(E) and S_ref,k=A_ref(E) from the exact selected CCF revision; response T_X values are not S_k
k=Planck_gain: S_k=G_SZ and S_ref,k=G_ref from the exact selected map-release calibration; P_SZ values are not S_k
GROUP_SOURCE_AUDIT_LANES: k=instrument_effective_area: S_k=A_inst(E) and S_ref,k=A_ref(E) from the selected CALDB/CCF revision
k=SZ_or_flux_gain when present: S_k=G_inst and S_ref,k=G_ref from the selected release calibration

dimensionless_predictor.source_selection_rule: Each S_ref is the nominal value in an exact hash-bound release file; until those release identifiers are selected per lane, calibration remains SOURCE_DEFINITION_BLOCKED.

variable_registry.physical_provenance: Instrument or distance-scale calibration releases and their covariance, treated as nuisance information rather than a new physical law.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Integrate shared calibration draws across all rows and endpoints affected by one calibration source; do not diagonalize a common scale uncertainty.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: A missing calibration lineage blocks the lane; no default zero uncertainty and no calibration inferred from fit residuals.

domain_applicability.blocker: distance, inclination, flux, and mass-to-light covariance is not joined in a clean predictor-only packet
full XMM/Planck shared and cross-endpoint calibration covariance is not bound
exact observation and calibration lineage is incomplete for every audited group lane

prospective_test.falsification_rule: Require the candidate advantage to survive the preregistered joint calibration prior without posterior mass at a calibration boundary; disappearance under documented calibration uncertainty identifies calibration sensitivity rather than new physics.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Compare joint correlated calibration draws against delta_cal=0 and against an intentionally diagonalized wrong-covariance control.

variable_registry.label: unresolved gas-density clumping

dimensionless_predictor.definition: <n_e^2>_shell/<n_e>_shell^2 within the same deprojected radial shell and frozen mask
dimensionless_predictor.reference_convention: shell edges, mask, background model, and mean-versus-median estimator must be frozen in the source packet before any response score

variable_registry.physical_provenance: Mean-to-median surface-brightness or validated fluctuation measurements with background, PSF, masking, and deprojection covariance.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Propagate C_rho jointly into density, gas mass, pressure, and baryonic acceleration; preserve radial/background covariance.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: No C_rho=1 default for missing outer bins in the primary analysis; use explicit missingness sensitivity and a separately labeled no-clumping ablation.

domain_applicability.blocker: cold-disk gas inhomogeneity requires a separately defined observable and is not C_rho
object-level clumping profiles with joint covariance are not bound
no group clumping product or background covariance is verified

prospective_test.falsification_rule: After jointly correcting density and gas mass with frozen C_rho, require held-out residual reduction without reversing the correction sign; no improvement falsifies clumping as the shared cause at the measured precision.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Set C_rho=1 and compare with full correlated C_rho posterior while holding all other nuisance draws fixed.

variable_registry.label: outer boundary and finite-observation support

dimensionless_predictor.definition: b_P=G*P_out/a0^2 for hydrostatic lanes; b_R=R_last/Rbar90 for the rotation lane
dimensionless_predictor.physical_range: positive; b_P and b_R are typed predictors and must never be pooled as the same measurement

reference_convention.hydrostatic_P_out: the unscored outer SZ boundary measurement at the frozen outer integration radius, stored in a predictor-only boundary file disjoint from scored interior P_SZ rows
reference_convention.hydrostatic_P_ref: a0^2/G using the globally frozen a0 and gravitational constant G; no P500, T500, scored T_X, or scored P_SZ normalization
reference_convention.rotation_R_last: largest radius for which all required predictor-only baryonic components are present; Vobs availability cannot set R_last
reference_convention.rotation_Rbar90: radius enclosing 90 percent of gas-plus-stellar baryonic mass in the frozen predictor maps

variable_registry.physical_provenance: An independently measured outer SZ pressure boundary or predictor-only radial-coverage ratio fixed before response scoring.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Carry the boundary posterior through the full radial integration; share reference-scale covariance and keep the two typed lane definitions separate.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: Missing P_out or R_bar90 blocks the primary boundary test; no extrapolation from the candidate response or fitted outer residual.
forbidden_response_derived_substitutes: P500 or T500 response scale used as predictor
scored T_X or interior P_SZ normalization
Vobs availability used to set R_last

domain_applicability.blocker: clean predictor-only R_last and R_bar90 packet cannot be opened under the mixed-file incident
boundary-method label is frozen, but measured predictor-only P_out and scale mapping are unavailable
direct outer pressure endpoint and covariance are absent

prospective_test.falsification_rule: Freeze boundary measurements before response access and require sensitivity-bounded predictions across radial coverage; a result driven by one boundary prior edge or background-method singleton fails the boundary robustness gate.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Replace the measured boundary posterior with the frozen neutral boundary and separately remove the radial-coverage term without changing object splits.

variable_registry.label: external acceleration and tidal environment

dimensionless_predictor.reference_convention: T_ext^TF has components d(g_ext,i)/d(x_j)-delta_ij*trace(dg/dx)/3; ||T_ext^TF||_F=sqrt(sum_ij(T_ij^2)); Rbar50 encloses 50 percent of predictor-side baryonic mass within frozen support; g_ext and T_ext exclude the target object's own source model

variable_registry.physical_provenance: Neighbor positions and independently calibrated baryonic or dynamical source estimates with survey selection and line-of-sight uncertainty.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Marginalize neighbor distance, membership, source mass proxy, incompleteness, and tidal-tensor covariance; report acceleration and tidal terms separately before any combination.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: Catalog footprint or redshift incompleteness is an explicit censoring state; never encode isolated=0 solely because neighbors are missing.
forbidden_response_derived_substitutes: host mass inferred from target response

domain_applicability.blocker: no frozen neighbor join, completeness model, or covariance
no bound external-field or tidal predictor packet
group aliases and environment joins are not frozen

prospective_test.falsification_rule: Freeze eta_env from a response-blind catalog and require the same signed residual relation or held-out improvement across eligible populations; catalog-incompleteness sensitivity or inconsistent signs falsify a shared environment cause.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Set eta_env=0, then remove acceleration and tidal components separately while preserving the frozen neighbor catalog and splits.

variable_registry.label: assembly, merger, sloshing, and relaxation time

dimensionless_predictor.physical_range: tau_asm>=0; categorical flags remain proxies and are not numeric tau_asm
dimensionless_predictor.event_convention: latest externally identified merger or interaction with predictor-side baryonic mass ratio mu>=1/4 and pericenter<=2*Rbar90; sloshing-only onset is retained as a separate categorical proxy and cannot define t_since_major_event
dimensionless_predictor.dynamical_time_convention: t_dyn(Rbar50)=sqrt(Rbar50^3/(G*Mbar(<Rbar50))); Rbar50 encloses 50 percent of predictor-side gas-plus-stellar baryonic mass within frozen support
dimensionless_predictor.clock_convention: t_since_major_event is source-reported lookback time relative to the observation epoch, with cosmology and event-time posterior frozen by the source packet

variable_registry.physical_provenance: Independent dynamical, morphological, spectral-age, or simulation-calibrated event-time posterior fixed without candidate residuals.
variable_registry.covariance_nuisance_treatment: Carry event-time and t_dyn covariance; analyze positive literature classifications separately from explicitly unclassified objects, never as positive versus confirmed negative.
variable_registry.missingness_rule: Unclassified is missing, not relaxed or no-merger; categorical proxy tests retain an explicit unclassified class and continuous tau_asm is not imputed.

domain_applicability.blocker: no hash-bound interaction or star-formation-history predictor packet
positive assembly and relaxation proxies are frozen, but no continuous event-time posterior exists
aliases and assembly metadata are not bound

prospective_test.falsification_rule: Freeze tau_asm or the declared proxy before response access and require a preregistered temporal ordering of residuals plus held-out improvement; no ordering, sign reversal, or dependence on treating unclassified as negative falsifies assembly as the shared cause.
prospective_test.ablation_rule: Remove tau_asm, then remove relaxation and positive-assembly proxy channels separately; keep unclassified objects explicitly unclassified.

next_actionable_acquisition.action: Obtain an official retrievable X-GAP master alias manifest or an authoritative replacement, freeze its bytes, aliases, per-file terms, and X-COP overlap before opening any scientific payload.
next_actionable_acquisition.unlocks: Group identity reconciliation and source planning for all seven variables; it does not by itself unlock a score or complete a missing-variable measurement.
